It remembers what you're working on, keeps unfinished jobs moving while you're away, and picks a project back up weeks later without starting over. Melete Cloud is open for waitlist signups. For companies, we're taking a small number of pilot teams.

title: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra: Run 120B AI models locally on Microsoft's new Surface | Product Hunt
og:title: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra: Run 120B AI models locally on Microsoft's new Surface | Product Hunt
og:description: Surface Laptop Ultra is Microsoft's most powerful Surface yet, powered by NVIDIA's RTX Spark Superchip. With Blackwell RTX graphics, up to 128GB of unified memory, and support for running AI models up to 120B parameters locally, it's built for developers, creators, and AI enthusiasts who want serious computing power without relying on the cloud. All packed into a 15-inch touchscreen laptop weighing under 4.5 lbs.

title: Mintlify: The intelligent knowledge platform | Product Hunt
og:title: Mintlify: The intelligent knowledge platform | Product Hunt
og:description: The next generation of documentation. AI-native, beautiful out-of-the-box, and built for collaboration.

title: miso.com: Book flights and hotels through iMessage | Product Hunt
og:title: miso.com: Book flights and hotels through iMessage | Product Hunt
og:description: Stop opening 20 tabs to book a trip. Miso is an AI travel agent in iMessage that finds, books, and manages flights and hotels for you. Just text where you want to go and Miso searches live options, learns your travel preferences, and handles the booking in the same conversation. With direct airline access and 24/7 support, you can go from “I need to be in London Tuesday” to booked without leaving Messages.

title: Mistral AI: Open and portable generative AI for devs and businesses | Product Hunt
og:title: Mistral AI: Open and portable generative AI for devs and businesses | Product Hunt
og:description:
- We’re committed to empower the AI community with open technology. Our open models sets the bar for efficiency, and are available for free, with fully permissive license. 
- Our optimized commercial models are designed for performance and are available via our flexible deployment options.

title: Moonwalkers Dusk: Strap-on motorized wheels that let you walk twice as fast | Product Hunt
og:title: Moonwalkers Dusk: Strap-on motorized wheels that let you walk twice as fast | Product Hunt
og:description: Discover Moonwalkers Dusk electric shoes by Shift Robotics. Our lightest robotic shoes yet, with three sizes, three finishes, and speeds up to 7 mph.

title: Moxie: Use any AI with Claude Code, switch accounts mid-task | Product Hunt
og:title: Moxie: Use any AI with Claude Code, switch accounts mid-task | Product Hunt
og:description: Moxie is a Mac menu bar app for Claude Code. Use your ChatGPT plan, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter or local models in Ollama, all from the Claude Code you already use. Hit a usage limit? Pick another account in one click and keep the same session going. Every account's 5-hour and weekly limits sit in the menu bar.

title: Murmur: A private voice-first notepad for your thoughts | Product Hunt
og:title: Murmur: A private voice-first notepad for your thoughts | Product Hunt
og:description: Murmur is a private, voice-first memory for your thoughts. Speak instead of typing, and Murmur turns your fleeting thoughts into searchable memories. Later, ask what you were thinking about, rediscover forgotten ideas, or send a thought to your future self with Future Capsules. No feeds. No followers. Just your thoughts, remembered.

title: Muse by Meta: Your personal AI agent that gets things done | Product Hunt
og:title: Muse by Meta: Your personal AI agent that gets things done | Product Hunt
og:description: Try Muse, your personal AI agent that gets things done. Give Muse a goal or an everyday task and it handles the rest, from finances and health to shopping and the people you care about.

title: Netra: A watchful notch with tools to keep you focused | Product Hunt
og:title: Netra: A watchful notch with tools to keep you focused | Product Hunt
og:description: Your Mac notch is empty black space. This puts a pair of cute eyes there. They follow your cursor, blink, and look sleepy when you step away. Click them and you get the useful stuff: a focus timer, a clipboard, a shelf to hold files you are working on, music controls for Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube, and a simple view of which apps you used.It stays in the notch. No extra window. The eyes are the fun part. The tools are why you might keep it.

title: Never Boring AI: The AI agent that writes your LinkedIn posts in your voice | Product Hunt
og:title: Never Boring AI: The AI agent that writes your LinkedIn posts in your voice | Product Hunt
og:description: Never Boring AI is an AI agent for LinkedIn. It interviews you about your work, keeps your stories in memory and turns them into posts written in your voice. It plans your content weeks ahead, learns from every edit you make, then schedules and publishes on LinkedIn for you. Built for freelancers, consultants and founders who know what they do but never know what to post this week. Works in English and French.

title: Notch Radio: Internet radio that lives in your MacBook's notch | Product Hunt
og:title: Notch Radio: Internet radio that lives in your MacBook's notch | Product Hunt
og:description: Notch Radio turns your MacBook's notch into a live radio. Hover it and it morphs into a full player with album art, real track titles and transport controls. Move away and it folds back into the hardware. Thousands of stations from the Radio Browser directory. Free for ever with five stations. One payment unlocks the rest: $9.99 at launch until 19 October, then $19.99. Nothing renews. No account, no analytics, no server. A notch is not required.

title: NotchMate: Makes your Notch more fun, interactive and useful. | Product Hunt
og:title: NotchMate: Makes your Notch more fun, interactive and useful. | Product Hunt
og:description: NotchMate puts Notchy, a small furry monster, in your notch. It peeks, waves on unlock, wears glasses during focus, and goes quiet when you're busy. Open the notch for: -Music with album art and controls -Zen: synced karaoke lyrics or ambient visuals -Weather, calendar, Pomodoro -Clipboard history and file shelf -Window snap and camera mirror -Lid fold: the desktop folds as you close it Customize its color and fur. macOS 14+, works also without a notch, I added 9 languages.

title: NotchMind: Put your MacBook notch to work: music, files, timers & more | Product Hunt
og:title: NotchMind: Put your MacBook notch to work: music, files, timers & more | Product Hunt
og:description: NotchMind turns your MacBook notch into a home for music, files, clipboard history, timers, downloads and 28 everyday tools. Native macOS app, one-time purchase.

title: Notchware: Music and AI agent alerts in your MacBook notch | Product Hunt
og:title: Notchware: Music and AI agent alerts in your MacBook notch | Product Hunt
og:description: That notch at the top of your MacBook does nothing. Notchware turns it into a live island: Now Playing with artwork and playback controls, plus battery, volume, brightness, Focus, and Wi-Fi status right where you look. Notchware Pro ($3.99 one-time) adds Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor alerts, so you know the moment an agent needs approval or finishes, without watching the terminal. Native SwiftUI. No account, no analytics, no cloud. macOS 14.6+.

title: NoteWorthy: Notes supercharged with AI, all on-device | Product Hunt
og:title: NoteWorthy: Notes supercharged with AI, all on-device | Product Hunt
og:description: Yet another notes app with AI? Nah. This one is supercharged, and the AI never leaves your device. Jot anything down and NoteWorthy titles it and files it under Tasks, Ideas, Info, Personal or your own labels. One tap turns a messy brain-dump into clean headings and checklists. Long note? Summed up in a line. It all runs on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Works offline, no account, no subscription, and not a single note sent to a server. Free. ⚡️

title: NOVA: AI coding that goes beyond suggestions | Product Hunt
og:title: NOVA: AI coding that goes beyond suggestions | Product Hunt
og:description: Every developer knows the loop: write code, run it, it breaks, paste the error into ChatGPT, fix, repeat. AI tools haven't solved this. They've just moved the chat window closer. NOVA kills that loop. Build: Describe your goal, NOVA writes the files. Auto-Heal: Run your code, NOVA fixes errors automatically. Janitor: Refactor any file on demand. Git: Commit, push, pull inside the terminal. pip install nova-bridgeye What would make this irreplaceable for you?

title: Octri.dev: Generate customizable Docs, SDKs, MCP server, and monitoring | Product Hunt
og:title: Octri.dev: Generate customizable Docs, SDKs, MCP server, and monitoring | Product Hunt
og:description: Upload an OpenAPI spec and Octri generates a fully customizable documentation site, high-quality client SDKs in ten languages (TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Dart) and an MCP server so AI agents can call your API. The new part: every SDK reports its own production errors back, so you see integration failures before your users file tickets. GitHub sync regenerates everything on every merge.

title: Odyssey 3: A world model that simulates physics in real time | Product Hunt
og:title: Odyssey 3: A world model that simulates physics in real time | Product Hunt
og:description: Odyssey-3 is a foundation world model that generates interactive environments from a prompt and predicts in real time how they change as you or an agent act in them. Its Pro version posts the highest reported Physics-IQ Verified video-to-video score (66.1, best-of-8). The same model has been adapted to control robot arms and humanoids, drive a car, and train agents. Try the research preview, or get in touch for API access.x`

title: Off the Record: Block AI from transcribing your meetings. | Product Hunt
og:title: Off the Record: Block AI from transcribing your meetings. | Product Hunt
og:description: Off the Record reshapes your voice in real time so people can understand you while AI notetakers and hidden interview copilots struggle to transcribe it.

title: offstage: Your computer-use agent gets a Mac account, not your screen | Product Hunt
og:title: offstage: Your computer-use agent gets a Mac account, not your screen | Product Hunt
og:description: offstage gives Claude Code, Codex and opencode a second, logged-in macOS account to work in. Simulators, Xcode UI tests and the app your agent just built open on that account's desktop, so your screen, keyboard and mouse stay yours. Free and open source: https://github.com/viraatdas/offstage

title: Omnia: Become the brand AI recommends | Product Hunt
og:title: Omnia: Become the brand AI recommends | Product Hunt
og:description: Omnia is an AI visibility tool that shows how AI sees your brand and helps you take action. Discover real AI prompts, monitor brand presence, benchmark competitors, and create content that boosts visibility and citations in AI search.

title: Oogwai Beacon: Answer Engine Optimization Audit | Product Hunt
og:title: Oogwai Beacon: Answer Engine Optimization Audit | Product Hunt
og:description: Most AEO tools score your HTML and call it AI visibility. Beacon actually asks the engines. We put unbranded buyer questions about your category to ChatGPT and Gemini (Claude on the full audit), then show how often you're named, who gets named instead, and which sources the engines trust. Two separate answers: can AI crawlers read your site (instant, no sign-up), and do the engines recommend you? Every gap comes with the fix.

title: Open Inspector: Hover any website, get its design system. No permissions. | Product Hunt
og:title: Open Inspector: Hover any website, get its design system. No permissions. | Product Hunt
og:description: A free, open-source browser extension for inspecting layout, styles, colour, type and assets on any page, and exporting its design tokens. Unlike the popular alternatives, it requests no site access and makes zero network requests. MIT, no account.

title: OpenBot: Grok Bot alternative: free, local, open-source, multiplayer | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenBot: Grok Bot alternative: free, local, open-source, multiplayer | Product Hunt
og:description: OpenBot is an open-source workspace for AI teammates. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, OpenCode, or custom agents on Mac, Windows, and iOS. Give agents clear roles, let them delegate work, and invite your team to collaborate live with the same agents.

title: OpenCharm: Open-source body for the AI agent you already run | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenCharm: Open-source body for the AI agent you already run | Product Hunt
og:description: OpenCharm is an open-source body for the AI agent you already run, right by your Mac's notch. Hold one key to talk and Claude Code, Codex or any agent gets to work, answers out loud and asks when it needs you. Next, it hangs from your keychain.

title: OpenCompanion: Start, watch and answer AI coding CLIs from one desktop app | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenCompanion: Start, watch and answer AI coding CLIs from one desktop app | Product Hunt
og:description: When you run Claude Code, Codex CLI or OpenCode in several folders at once, each session stops now and then to ask for permission, and you only find out when you look at its terminal. OpenCompanion starts those sessions, lists them on one screen, tells you when one is waiting, and lets you answer from the desktop or from your phone on the same Wi-Fi. No account, no cloud server, no telemetry. Open source (MIT), for Windows, Linux and macOS.

title: Opengeni: Ship AI agents within minutes. Infrastructure for Agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Opengeni: Ship AI agents within minutes. Infrastructure for Agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Everything your AI agents need in production, out of the box: sessions that survive errors, sandboxes, 100+ integrations, human approvals and insights into every step and dollar. Go live in hours. Self-host it free, or start on our cloud.

title: OpenPilot: Open-source desktop AI agent for any model you choose | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenPilot: Open-source desktop AI agent for any model you choose | Product Hunt
og:description: OpenPilot is a free, MIT-licensed desktop AI agent. Connect any OpenAI-compatible model (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio), pick a folder, and it reads and edits files and runs commands there. You approve sensitive actions. Windows now, macOS early beta.

title: opensend.cc: The open source email platform that runs on your server | Product Hunt
og:title: opensend.cc: The open source email platform that runs on your server | Product Hunt
og:description: opensend.cc is an open source email platform that runs on your server. It sends through your own AWS account, so your domain, your data and your sender reputation stay yours. You get a REST API and SDK, SMTP, templates, broadcasts, automations, audiences, webhooks and logs. One command installs it. No per-email pricing, no feature gates. Already on Resend? Change two lines and keep your code.

title: OpenSEO: The open source Ahrefs alternative | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenSEO: The open source Ahrefs alternative | Product Hunt
og:description: Without good data, your agent gives generic advice. Keyword research, competitor research, backlinks and site audits, starting at $10/month instead of a $100-plus monthly subscription. Connect with MCP so that you can work with your agent to build an SEO strategy and write content tailored to your company.

title: OpenSwarm: A swarm of agents, in the same place you work | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenSwarm: A swarm of agents, in the same place you work | Product Hunt
og:description: Stop bolting AI onto your computer. OpenSwarm is an AI-first operating system where agents run the whole machine: apps create themselves, browsers control themselves, and swarms of agents work together. Your OS just became an infinite canvas, and your work just transformed from you doing one task at a time, to orchestrating dozens in parallel. Tell it what you want and a swarm of agents does the work with you at the helm.

title: OpenVids: Open-source video editor you run by chatting with AI agents | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenVids: Open-source video editor you run by chatting with AI agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Open-source, agent-first AI video editor for macOS and Windows. Describe the film — agents cut the timeline, add motion and sound, and review the render.

title: Opposable: Computer use for phones to give your AI thumbs | Product Hunt
og:title: Opposable: Computer use for phones to give your AI thumbs | Product Hunt
og:description: Opposable lets Claude Code, Codex or any MCP agent see, tap and type on a real iPhone or Android phone, in every app you're signed into. Common tasks run on the phone with no model at all, payments wait for your tap, and iPhones work through Bluetooth or a tiny USB stick.

title: OrgComputers: Workspace for your AI Agents | Product Hunt
og:title: OrgComputers: Workspace for your AI Agents | Product Hunt
og:description: OrgComputers is a shared workspace for your AI agents. Projects, context and tools in one place, so Claude Code, Cursor and Codex start with what your team already knows.

title: OTPfill: Autofill OTP codes from your email on Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: OTPfill: Autofill OTP codes from your email on Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: OTPfill is a Mac menu-bar app. When a site emails you a verification code, it appears under the code field. Click Fill.

title: Otter Vault: Catch API keys the moment they appear, encrypted locally | Product Hunt
og:title: Otter Vault: Catch API keys the moment they appear, encrypted locally | Product Hunt
og:description: Otter Vault catches API keys the moment they appear and keeps them encrypted on your own device. Watch the demo and leave a reply, no account needed.

title: Ownfeed: A social feed of people who need your product | Product Hunt
og:title: Ownfeed: A social feed of people who need your product | Product Hunt
og:description: Paste your product's URL. Every day, Ownfeed reads Reddit, X, Bluesky and Hacker News and keeps only the posts from people who need what you built. No keywords, no alert inbox, no auto-replies. You scroll for five minutes and reply yourself.

title: ParakeetAI: Your real-time AI interview help. | Product Hunt
og:title: ParakeetAI: Your real-time AI interview help. | Product Hunt
og:description: Your real-time AI interview help. Boost Your Interview Performance with AI.

title: Pastily: Your clipboard but better | Product Hunt
og:title: Pastily: Your clipboard but better | Product Hunt
og:description: Fast, private clipboard manager for macOS, Windows and Linux. Searchable copy history, paste queue, images and snippets. 100% offline, pay once.

title: Patchcord: Studio sound for your mic in every Mac meeting with EQ | Product Hunt
og:title: Patchcord: Studio sound for your mic in every Mac meeting with EQ | Product Hunt
og:description: Patchcord is a macOS menu bar app that runs any Audio Unit plugin on your mic and hands the result to Zoom, Teams, Meet or Discord as a virtual mic. Use free plugins like RNNoise or pro tools like Antinode Clear. Every mic gets its own EQ with a live spectrum, switching mics mid-call just works, and Patchcord Camera keeps you in lip sync. Free to use, 7-day Pro trial, Pro is a one-time purchase. No account, no subscription.

title: Paw-Paw: A tiny desktop pet for your Mac that types along with you | Product Hunt
og:title: Paw-Paw: A tiny desktop pet for your Mac that types along with you | Product Hunt
og:description: A small illustrated animal sits in the corner of your Mac's screen, reacts as you type and click, and naps when you pause. Choose which season earns XP and unlock dozens of Paw-Paws and 100+ items as you level up. Free and native; one optional $2.99 add-on.

title: Phare C1®: A smoke alarm that detects fire, not toast. | Product Hunt
og:title: Phare C1®: A smoke alarm that detects fire, not toast.  | Product Hunt
og:description: Phare C1 is a smoke alarm that sounds for actual emergencies and nothing else. Its multi-sensor array spots fire and CO early and accurately, reduces false alarms, and is backed by detection algorithms that learn and improve to make your home even safer over time. It keeps much-loved features from the Nest Protect (RIP) like early warnings, a night light, and in-app alerts, and adds new ones like air quality monitoring and intruder detection.

title: Pheebs: Measure how engineers and teams actually work with AI | Product Hunt
og:title: Pheebs: Measure how engineers and teams actually work with AI | Product Hunt
og:description: Measure how you and your team actually work with AI coding agents. Pheebs is an open-source AI telemetry tool created by Eversynced. It sits quietly inside Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via hooks, capturing lightweight interaction signals: the shape of the session, not its contents.

title: Phonable: Missed calls, handled: callers get a text, you get the gist | Product Hunt
og:title: Phonable: Missed calls, handled: callers get a text, you get the gist | Product Hunt
og:description: Phonable replaces your carrier voicemail on iPhone and fixes both sides of a missed call. Your caller gets a text after a missed call, so they know why you couldn't pick up, even if they hang up without leaving a voicemail. You get the gist: voicemails arrive transcribed with a short AI summary. Switch modes like Workday, Driving or Gym in one tap or on a schedule, greet callers in your own voice or a natural AI voice, and keep your own number.

title: Pilot5.ai: Your question, deliberated by 5 frontier AI models | Product Hunt
og:title: Pilot5.ai: Your question, deliberated by 5 frontier AI models | Product Hunt
og:description: Pilot5.ai gives legal work an adversarial second opinion. Five frontier AI models analyze the same matter independently, challenge each other anonymously, and converge on a recommendation — while preserving the strongest objection. Research runs against primary legal sources, claims are tagged as sourced or inferred, and case citations are checked for existence. Built for lawyers who want AI analysis they can inspect, challenge, and defend.

title: Pine Computer: A cloud computer built for AI to get jobs done | Product Hunt
og:title: Pine Computer: A cloud computer built for AI to get jobs done | Product Hunt
og:description: Pine Computer is a cloud computer built for AI to use. Your product hands it a job: research, forms, spreadsheets, portals with no API. The finished work comes back. AI reads each app's structure instead of pixels, is told when something changes, and gets as many virtual screens as it needs. Spin up a computer per customer through one SDK, bring your own model or use ours, and let a person take over for sign-ins or approvals. Invite-only beta.

title: Pixel Soup: Dithered live wallpapers your Mac cooks up itself | Product Hunt
og:title: Pixel Soup: Dithered live wallpapers your Mac cooks up itself | Product Hunt
og:description: Pixel Soup makes your Mac's wallpaper for you. Pick a shape, a palette and a dither style, and it draws it live on your GPU, then keeps it gently moving behind your icons or freezes it as a still. Drop in a photo and it dithers that too. Hit one button for a random new wallpaper, or let it serve a fresh one every hour. No account, no tracking, no subscription. One payment and it is yours.

title: Plugins Radar: Search rankings and competitor alerts for ChatGPT plugins | Product Hunt
og:title: Plugins Radar: Search rankings and competitor alerts for ChatGPT plugins | Product Hunt
og:description: Plugins Radar tracks the ChatGPT plugin directory. Look up any of 5,000+ plugins to see where it ranks in 192 common searches, which plugins compete with it and which searches it misses. Add your plugin and the rivals you watch, and get an email when one passes you or edits its listing. Topic leaderboards are free. Sign up free and track a plugin to see its full report.

title: pmtui: Autopilot for long-running AI sessions in terminal | Product Hunt
og:title: pmtui: Autopilot for long-running AI sessions in terminal | Product Hunt
og:description: pmtui focuses on managing multiple agents and solving long-horizon tasks. Autopilot does what an agent loop does, except loops drift once the work runs long. So pmtui keeps the loop outside the agent and rebuilds the prompt each time from your goal and the agent's own last status. You choose how often to check back, and it only surfaces what really needs your attention

title: Poddle: Swing your phone, play pickleball on any computer! | Product Hunt
og:title: Poddle: Swing your phone, play pickleball on any computer! | Product Hunt
og:description: Poddle is Wii Sports-style pickleball for your browser, played only with the devices you already own. Open poddleball.com on any computer, scan the QR code, and your phone becomes the paddle. On a Mac, one AirPod can be the paddle instead; a small open-source helper app streams its motion sensors to the game, and the other AirPod stays in the case. Play a friend online, take on Matt the bot at four difficulty levels, or run a tournament, and earn trophies as you go. 100% fun and free to play!

title: Polylane: AI agents that fix production before you wake up | Product Hunt
og:title: Polylane: AI agents that fix production before you wake up | Product Hunt
og:description: Nobody should be on call. Polylane connects your code, infra and observability data, investigates every incident and opens a pull request with the fix. If code can't fix it, you get the root cause and a recommendation.

title: Porch: ocal project summaries and cost tracking for AI coding | Product Hunt
og:title: Porch: ocal project summaries and cost tracking for AI coding | Product Hunt
og:description: Porch turns your Claude Code and Codex work into daily, weekly, and monthly summaries by project, with estimated task time and blockers. See sessions across terminals and editors, know which need your attention, track tokens and API-equivalent costs, and save summaries as Markdown to Obsidian or any folder. Open source, with no Porch account required. Session status and usage stay on your Mac; summaries use your installed, signed-in Claude Code or Codex.

title: Postquel: Free native Postgres app for Mac with your own AI agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Postquel: Free native Postgres app for Mac with your own AI agents | Product Hunt
og:description: A fast, native PostgreSQL client for macOS. Its AI assistant runs on the Claude Code, Codex or Cursor account you already pay for, sees your real schema, and can only read: any change it suggests waits for you to dry-run and apply. Free and open source.

title: Prefer: The execution layer for AEO | Product Hunt
og:title: Prefer: The execution layer for AEO | Product Hunt
og:description: AEO should not be another dashboard. Prefer works at the execution layer, helping brands understand how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity talk about them, identify where they are missing, and take action to improve their visibility. Turn AI search insights into action with autonomous agents. Less reporting. More doing.

title: ProcBoss: Run, deploy, monitor, and manage your apps across servers | Product Hunt
og:title: ProcBoss: Run, deploy, monitor, and manage your apps across servers | Product Hunt
og:description: ProcBoss is a lightweight production process and infrastructure management platform for running, deploying, and monitoring applications across servers. Run Node.js, Bun, Deno, & other runtimes with clustering, automatic restarts, health checks, dependencies, cron jobs, logs, metrics, and GitHub auto-deployments. ProcBoss Cloud adds centralized server monitoring, deployment management, alerts, and hosted status pages; giving developers one place to keep production applications running reliably.

title: Proofsource: AI search visibility, with agents that fix the gaps | Product Hunt
og:title: Proofsource: AI search visibility, with agents that fix the gaps  | Product Hunt
og:description: When a buyer asks ChatGPT for the best tool in your category, it names five or six companies and stops. Proofsource shows whether you're one of them. It asks your buyers' questions on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews every day, shows who gets named instead and why, maps the pages AI trusts, and drafts the fixes. You approve; our agents publish, verify the answers changed, and learn from every change. Start free: 25 questions, 4 engines, no card.

title: qarunbook: A test plan your team and your AI can work through | Product Hunt
og:title: qarunbook: A test plan your team and your AI can work through | Product Hunt
og:description: qarunbook helps you write a clear test plan, work through it yourself, with your team or with your AI over MCP, and keep track of what needs fixing or checking again. A fixed issue waits for a retest before it counts as passed. Free plan, no card.

title: Quven: The self-hosted media server that puts native playback first | Product Hunt
og:title: Quven: The self-hosted media server that puts native playback first | Product Hunt
og:description: A self-hosted media server for films, series and documentaries, with music and ebooks on desktop and web. Native apps for desktop, iPhone, iPad, Android, Android TV and Fire TV. Free for personal use, with hardware transcoding and no ads.

title: Ranktune: Track AI visibility, citations, and referral traffic | Product Hunt
og:title: Ranktune: Track AI visibility, citations, and referral traffic | Product Hunt
og:description: Track how your brand appears across AI search, see which AI platforms are sending traffic to your website, and uncover opportunities to improve your visibility. Ranktune combines AI visibility monitoring, citation tracking, referral traffic analytics, and content optimization in one platform.

title: Rate.fm: Letterboxd for music, on iPhone | Product Hunt
og:title: Rate.fm: Letterboxd for music, on iPhone | Product Hunt
og:description: - Rate songs and albums out of 10. - Write reviews. - Keep a listening diary. - Follow friends to see their ratings. - Follow critics and publications. - Reviews are also available in the app. - Native iOS 26+ with Liquid Glass, Apple Music and Spotify integrations, synced lyrics on the player with Genius annotations, widgets, and a live activity to see what friends thought. - Free, badge subscription to support the app

title: Reactive Resume: A free and open-source resume builder | Product Hunt
og:title: Reactive Resume: A free and open-source resume builder | Product Hunt
og:description: Reactive Resume is a free and open-source resume builder that simplifies the process of creating, updating, and sharing your resume.

title: Reassign: Your day, shaped into a story. The planner for makers | Product Hunt
og:title: Reassign: Your day, shaped into a story. The planner for makers | Product Hunt
og:description: Let the shape of your day tell the story. Reassign is a 24-hour circular planner for busy makers. Midnight up top, noon at the bottom. Drag to block time. Reshape it when plans fall apart. It speaks AI. Brain-dump or brainstorm into the command palette and watch AI rebuild your afternoon, live. It mirrors everything. Google Calendar, Outlook, Todoist, Linear, all in two-way sync. Plus focus mode and an energy curve from your sleep. One dial. Every source. Full control.

title: Redlamp: Native, open-source RAW Lightroom alternative editor for Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: Redlamp: Native, open-source RAW Lightroom alternative editor for Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: Redlamp is a native, open-source RAW photo editor for Apple Silicon, built from scratch in Swift and Metal. Lightroom's workflow, with no subscription and no cloud.

title: Refs: Give Claude better references for your launch film | Product Hunt
og:title: Refs: Give Claude better references for your launch film | Product Hunt
og:description: Refs is a library of 2400+ films that moved people, each measured cut by cut and written up as a 15-plate blueprint with a recipe prompt. Add it to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor with one command, and Claude plans your launch film from the real thing.

title: Regunow: Turn regulatory research into actionable compliance audits | Product Hunt
og:title: Regunow: Turn regulatory research into actionable compliance audits | Product Hunt
og:description: Regunow helps you understand what regulations mean for your business before you launch, expand, or make a change. Describe your product, service, or target market in plain language and explore requirements with AI answers grounded in authoritative sources. Compare your documents with relevant rules, investigate possible gaps, translate regulatory material, and turn your findings into structured reports. Bring research across markets into one workspace, with sources you can check as you go.

title: Reika: A coding agent CLI designed around small local models first | Product Hunt
og:title: Reika: A coding agent CLI designed around small local models first | Product Hunt
og:description: Reika is a coding agent CLI for local and hosted models, designed around local models first. It doesn't make a small model more intelligent but it provides a better experience using them day to day. Even if you're not part of the absolute range that Reika is designed for, using larger local models or hosted ones will still provide a solid experience out of the box.

title: Request Eagle: Fast and open-source Postman alternative | Product Hunt
og:title: Request Eagle: Fast and open-source Postman alternative | Product Hunt
og:description: Request Eagle is an open-source API client written in Rust and drawn on the GPU, with no web view. It answers your first keystroke 0.36 s after launch, keeps requests as TOML files you can commit, runs Postman-style pm.* scripts and has a CLI for AI agents.

title: Revela: A film camera for iPhone that makes you wait for the lab | Product Hunt
og:title: Revela: A film camera for iPhone that makes you wait for the lab | Product Hunt
og:description: Revela is a film camera that lives in your phone. Pick a roll from a fridge of twelve original stocks, shoot it with no preview, then mail it to the lab and wait: an hour, overnight, or days. When the envelope arrives, pull the seal and see your photos for the first time. Prints develop from RAW with per-stock curves, grain and halation, and save to Photos at full resolution. Casual mode skips the wait. One price, no subscription, no account.

title: Review: Code review on your own machine, with your own AI | Product Hunt
og:title: Review: Code review on your own machine, with your own AI | Product Hunt
og:description: Free desktop app for reviewing Git branches and GitHub PRs. Comment on any line and keep comments private until you publish. Add AI reviewers with your own models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter or local via Ollama. Split the review across a team of models, see exactly which rules each one checked, and retry only what was missed. Open source (MIT), no account, for Mac, Windows and Linux.

title: Reviu: The review app for code your agent writes | Product Hunt
og:title: Reviu: The review app for code your agent writes | Product Hunt
og:description: Reviu is a native desktop app for reviewing agent-written code before you push. Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and other ACP agents in durable sessions, inspect every diff, send comments back to the agent, then stage, rebase, commit, open PRs and review GitHub pull requests without leaving the app.

title: Rhem Labs: Health assistant robots for your parents’ | Product Hunt
og:title: Rhem Labs: Health assistant robots for your parents’ | Product Hunt
og:description: Aging at home has a visibility problem. Small changes in health and routine can go unnoticed for weeks or months, until the first obvious sign is something serious. Rhem is a tabletop robot that helps families see those changes earlier, while giving parents the everyday support they need to stay independent longer. Rhem was designed first for aging parents, but anyone can use it as an extra set of eyes and everyday help at home.

title: rhun: A small, fast code editor written in assembly | Product Hunt
og:title: rhun: A small, fast code editor written in assembly | Product Hunt
og:description: A small code editor for Windows, Linux and macOS. Written in assembly, with a built-in terminal, Git diffs, fuzzy search, Vim mode and a panel for Claude Code and Codex sessions. Free and open source.

title: Rill Browser: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you | Product Hunt
og:title: Rill Browser: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you | Product Hunt
og:description: Rill is an AI-native browser built around the Claude Code and Codex you already use. Browse normally, then press ⌘E on any page to turn what you're looking at into a task for your agent. Rill finds the right project, passes along the context, and the agent works while you keep browsing. It also sorts your tabs into themes, turns your history into days you can search, and brings every project your agents are working on into one place. Free, on the plan you already have.

title: Rival Workshop: A bookshelf app to manage every skill your agents read | Product Hunt
og:title: Rival Workshop: A bookshelf app to manage every skill your agents read | Product Hunt
og:description: The Workshop app shows every skill in your repo as a book on a shelf: the spine is what Claude Code, Codex or Cursor reads before every task, and a bookend marks where each one stops. Switch skills off, make them run only when asked, rewrite them with Claude Code, and add good ones from the web after a safety check. One node command, and it runs on your computer. Includes 150 editable skills and Brief. One payment: $79 until Oct 31, 2026 (11:59 pm Pacific), then $149.

title: Rool: Your private AI machine. Files, ideas, AI in one workspace. | Product Hunt
og:title: Rool: Your private AI machine. Files, ideas, AI in one workspace. | Product Hunt
og:description: Rool is your private AI workspace. Bring your files, ideas and AI together in one place, on your own machine in the cloud. Unlike mainstream AI, Rool never sells your data, shows no ads and never uses your content to train AI. Your data is stored in Finland, under EU law. It's AI that runs on your terms, with full control and privacy. Built for privacy-conscious individuals, teams and creators. Try Rool free and own your AI.

title: Rune: Write it down on one Mac, find it on the other | Product Hunt
og:title: Rune: Write it down on one Mac, find it on the other | Product Hunt
og:description: Rune is a small, fast text editor for the Mac. One scratch file in iCloud Drive is shared by all your Macs: saved as you type, and edits from two Macs are merged, never overwritten. Plain-text paste, Sublime Text's colors and keys, and Find in History.

title: ruOS: A cloud desktop where AI agents do the work for you | Product Hunt
og:title: ruOS: A cloud desktop where AI agents do the work for you | Product Hunt
og:description: ruOS is a private cloud desktop with an AI team built in. Ask for research, writing or code and the agents (Claude Code, Codex, ruflo swarms) do it while you watch or step away. Opens in any browser on Mac, iPad or Chromebook, nothing to install. Files and AI memory persist across devices. Power users get a real Linux box plus an MCP server, so ChatGPT or Claude can drive it. Try ruOS Lite free in seconds, no sign-up.

title: Sayonic: A voice assistant in your Mac's notch that does the task | Product Hunt
og:title: Sayonic: A voice assistant in your Mac's notch that does the task | Product Hunt
og:description: Sayonic lives in your Mac's notch. Say what you want and it opens apps and tabs, finds files, adds notes and events, or hands the job to a coding agent you already use. From $3.99 a month per Mac with your own keys, or Pro and Max with Cloud credits included.

title: Scape: Build tools to automate your work & give them to your agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Scape: Build tools to automate your work & give them to your agents | Product Hunt
og:description: A macOS app that helps you build tools that can automate parts of your job. Give them to your agents to work like you. Build super-powered orchestrator agents to scale your output. Automate adversarial reviews between Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode.

title: SCMD : Manage what Claude Remembers and Keeps as Memory. | Product Hunt
og:title: SCMD : Manage what Claude Remembers and Keeps as Memory. | Product Hunt
og:description: Claude only! SCMD is an open-source, local review deck for the persistent memories Claude Code saves about you and your projects. Keep, delete, skip, undo, rewrite, and inspect why a memory was saved. Decisions stay staged until you confirm; deletes go to restorable trash. No telemetry, no cloud service, and zero npm dependencies. Run it with /scmd:run or npx. MIT-licensed and ready for contributors.

title: Scumble: The open-source editor for AI inpainting | Product Hunt
og:title: Scumble: The open-source editor for AI inpainting | Product Hunt
og:description: Scumble is a free, open-source desktop editor for AI inpainting. Select part of a picture, say what belongs there, and the result lands as its own colour-matched layer. Runs on your own ComfyUI or your own API keys: FLUX 3, GPT Image, Nano Banana and more.

title: Sellio: AI customer support in one shared inbox powered by AI agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Sellio: AI customer support in one shared inbox powered by AI agents | Product Hunt
og:description: AI customer support in one shared inbox: live chat, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, and email. AI agents trained on your docs, plus tickets and analytics.

title: Semitexa: The PHP framework your AI agent can actually inspect | Product Hunt
og:title: Semitexa: The PHP framework your AI agent can actually inspect | Product Hunt
og:description: Semitexa is an open-source PHP 8.4 framework for long-running Swoole servers and AI-assisted development. A project graph lets you (or your AI agent) query routes, dependencies and blast radius before editing. Pages render on the server and arrive in stages, with deferred blocks and live SSE updates and no second frontend. ORM, tenancy and queues are built in, and traces plus targeted tests verify every change. Explore 81 live demo routes, with the source next to each one.

title: Semwright: Give AI agents structured access to real software | Product Hunt
og:title: Semwright: Give AI agents structured access to real software | Product Hunt
og:description: Semwright is an open-source Rust runtime for AI agents working with desktop and professional software. Through structured drivers, agents can interact with application objects and project data, while a shared runtime handles permissions, execution, dependencies, artifact handoffs, and verification. It supports MCP without being limited to a single protocol, model, or agent. Build workflows across applications without rebuilding the same integration infrastructure for each one.

title: Sente: Talk to your coding agent | Product Hunt
og:title: Sente: Talk to your coding agent | Product Hunt
og:description: A coding agent you can talk to — in your terminal or on your phone. 1. Voice, both ways. Read one sentence (~10 sec) to enroll your voice. Consent-first; the delete key is yours. 2. 404 models on one account — Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and more. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible. 3. MIT open source: github.com/yukihamada/sente Japan-built: Tokyo region, JPY billing. Honest limits: metered, not unlimited. Monthly credits; top up if you go over. We never clone a voice that isn't yours.

title: ShareCube: Share what your agents make, get feedback on the exact line | Product Hunt
og:title: ShareCube: Share what your agents make, get feedback on the exact line | Product Hunt
og:description: ShareCube gives your AI agents a place to publish. From Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client, your agent posts an HTML or Markdown artifact to a project and hands you a link, not a wall of chat. Your team comments on the exact sentence, @mentions each other and resolves threads. The agent reads that feedback and ships the next version. Every save is versioned. Share privately, with your org, or publicly: anyone with the link can read it, no account needed.

title: ShipHQ: Build your own app studio, powered by your real apps | Product Hunt
og:title: ShipHQ: Build your own app studio, powered by your real apps | Product Hunt
og:description: ShipHQ turns your app's real numbers into a living isometric startup office. Connect RevenueCat and every paying subscriber becomes a person at your desks. Each morning the Daily Brief replays last night: new subscribers walk in to applause, trials arrive in caps, churn gets a send-off. Milestones land as trophies on your wall — earned, never bought, never retroactive. AI managers bring a 09:00 standup on growth, reviews and competitors. Free on iPhone.

title: Side: A little AI chat panel that lives beside your Mac's Dock | Product Hunt
og:title: Side: A little AI chat panel that lives beside your Mac's Dock | Product Hunt
og:description: Side is a tiny AI chat panel that sits right beside your Mac's Dock: one glance away, never in the way. • Fits the gap next to your Dock, floats above other windows, works across Spaces and full-screen apps • Switch providers, models and reasoning levels in one conversation • Bring your own account: sign in with ChatGPT or use an API key • Compact composer that expands to full height when needed • ⌘⇧Space to show or hide Free and open source (MIT).

title: Simo: The judgment layer for software that acts | Product Hunt
og:title: Simo: The judgment layer for software that acts | Product Hunt
og:description: Simo is the System 1.5 judgment model from Temprl Labs. Ask typed questions about text, screenshots, or video and get calibrated probabilities and the values needed to act, in milliseconds.

title: Simple Workout Log: The best minimalist workout tracker available | Product Hunt
og:title: Simple Workout Log: The best minimalist workout tracker available | Product Hunt
og:description: A clear record of your training, with room for what matters. Simple Workout Log is a minimalist workout journal designed to help you note what you did and find your starting point next time. Set up your account and training preferences on the web. Log strength and cardio workouts on mobile, follow your routines, and keep your training history in one place.

title: SineFrame M3: Test MCP servers and the agents that call them in pytest | Product Hunt
og:title: SineFrame M3: Test MCP servers and the agents that call them in pytest | Product Hunt
og:description: Your MCP unit tests pass, but did the agent call the tool? M3 runs your server through real Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Pi and asserts on the calls they actually made, in plain pytest. Direct tests need no API key. m3 ui shows every trace and tool call; m3 ci test --upload gates PRs and keeps runs on app.m3.sineframe.com. Open source, Apache-2.0.

title: Singularity: Run AI coding agents in parallel, one ticket at a time | Product Hunt
og:title: Singularity: Run AI coding agents in parallel, one ticket at a time | Product Hunt
og:description: Chatting with AI coding agents burns context and time. Singularity replaces the chat with atomic tickets: one scope, one isolated Git worktree, minimal context. Run agents in parallel across repos, review the diff, merge. Free, local-first, bring your own key.

title: Siteprint: Measure any website's design, then hand it to your AI | Product Hunt
og:title: Siteprint: Measure any website's design, then hand it to your AI | Product Hunt
og:description: Siteprint is a Safari extension for Mac that measures the design of any page: colours with their roles, type scale, spacing, corners and layout. Extract it as one exact prompt for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Runs on your Mac. $9.99 once.

title: slash-editor: Notion-style block editor for React. MIT, UI you own | Product Hunt
og:title: slash-editor: Notion-style block editor for React. MIT, UI you own | Product Hunt
og:description: slash-editor gives your React app the Notion block experience: a slash menu, drag handles, nested reorder, turn-into, comments and real-time collab. It runs on a headless Tiptap v3 core. The UI arrives through a shadcn registry, so the components land in your repo and follow your Tailwind tokens. Tables, columns, Mermaid, AI via your own model, markdown import/export. MIT end to end, no paid tier, nothing hosted.

title: Smooth Recorder: Mac screen recordings that look edited when you hit stop | Product Hunt
og:title: Smooth Recorder:   Mac screen recordings that look edited when you hit stop | Product Hunt
og:description: Smooth Recorder is a native Mac app for demos and tutorials. It zooms in where you click, smooths your cursor, adds captions on your Mac and puts it all on a nice background. Screenshots get the same features.

title: Snapset: Save and restore your entire Mac workspace in an instant | Product Hunt
og:title: Snapset: Save and restore your entire Mac workspace in an instant | Product Hunt
og:description: Apps, window positions, browser tabs, even the folders you had open. A Mac menu bar app that remembers your entire workspace, and rearranges it automatically when you plug into a different display.

title: Sorcrr: Ai enabled bounty driven referral platform for hiring & gtm | Product Hunt
og:title: Sorcrr: Ai enabled bounty driven referral platform for hiring & gtm | Product Hunt
og:description: You hit pmf, pick up funding - now scaling fast... bottleneck - hiring. So you hire hr, and they tell you "its going to take 3 months!!!" This is where Sorcrr comes in. Sorcrr lets you create a video job description. Put a bounty on it. Share on your socials and have referrals come in. Need more speed up the bounty. Add your team, then vote, review, leverage ai assisted interviews, setup trials, send hiring offers, and you're done. One mobile first app with everything built in.

title: Sorted: Your private AI file organizer for Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: Sorted: Your private AI file organizer for Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: Sorted turns a messy Mac file system into a private, searchable library. Drop files or watch folders and it reads PDFs and images with OCR, detects duplicates, applies local AI tags, follows your custom rules, and routes high-confidence matches automatically. Search by meaning, chat with documents using cited answers, review uncertain changes, undo anything, and export a clean Tax Pack for your accountant. Everything runs on your Mac. One-time $9.99 purchase.

title: SpeechShield: Live interview & meeting copilot for Mac, from your resume | Product Hunt
og:title: SpeechShield: Live interview & meeting copilot for Mac, from your resume | Product Hunt
og:description: SpeechShield listens to Zoom, Meet or Teams on your Mac and transcribes each question as it's asked. When the speaker pauses, it shows talking points built only from your resume and the job posting, or from the proposals and price lists you added for a client meeting, with the source. Also: live translated captions in 13 languages, a phone viewer you pair by QR, and an overlay that stays out of screen shares. Free with your own Claude Code, Codex or OpenAI key.

title: Spira AI: The #1 agent that runs your entire social | Product Hunt
og:title: Spira AI: The #1 agent that runs your entire social | Product Hunt
og:description: Built by the teams behind Creatify AI, TikTok, CapCut, Meta, Snap and Midjourney — Spira gives you autonomous AI Influencers that run your social media end-to-end 24/7. They catch trends before they peak, create content in your voice, and publish across TikTok, Instagram, X and more. You stay in control through your preferred chat app — or let them run completely on their own. 10M+ impressions before public launch. Your first AI Influencer is less than 10 minutes away.

title: Staffcoder: Build like a real engineer | Product Hunt
og:title: Staffcoder: Build like a real engineer | Product Hunt
og:description: Staffcoder is a hands-on coding platform where developers practice real engineering work instead of algorithm puzzles. Choose from 1000+ challenges across 39 learning paths, covering React, Next.js, Django, Spring Boot, Docker, Kubernetes, AI agents, and more. Every challenge runs in a full browser IDE with a real terminal, file system, and live preview, so there is nothing to install. Pick a stack, open a challenge, and build. Free to start.

title: Stardrift for iOS: The AI travel assistant in your pocket | Product Hunt
og:title: Stardrift for iOS: The AI travel assistant in your pocket | Product Hunt
og:description: Stardrift helps you plan your dream trip, day-by-day. There's so much stress involved in planning a trip: where should you go? How do you make the most of limited time, and avoid missing out on activities? Stardrift helps you build up a wishlist of places to go. Using what it knows about you, it helps you create a day-by-day plan and surface nearby recommendations you otherwise would have missed. And when you're on the go, it acts as your assistant, answering questions and sending alerts.

title: statusbar: a statusbar for any terminal | Product Hunt
og:title: statusbar: a statusbar for any terminal | Product Hunt
og:description: A status bar for any terminal.

title: StayCharted: Train AI on your own categories | Product Hunt
og:title: StayCharted: Train AI on your own categories | Product Hunt
og:description: Upload rows or photos your team has already sorted. StayCharted learns your categories and fills in the rest: support tickets, expense lines, survey answers, product photos. No prompts, no code. Answers it is unsure of come back to you to review. Start free.

title: StayLokal: Private file tools that run on your device. | Product Hunt
og:title: StayLokal: Private file tools that run on your device. | Product Hunt
og:description: StayLokal is a local-first file utility desk for PDFs, images, video, audio, and more.

title: Strac Comply: Get SOC 2 without the sales call | Product Hunt
og:title: Strac Comply: Get SOC 2 without the sales call | Product Hunt
og:description: 1. Self-serve compliance automation. Sign up, connect AWS, Google Workspace, Okta, GitHub and Slack, and 100+ tests run continuously for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS and more. 2. No per-framework fees 3. 14-day free trial, no credit card 4. Built by a data-security company, so it also finds the AI apps and agents in your workspace and maps them to the customer data they can reach 5. Run it from the dashboard or Claude Code via MCP 6. Platform $4,995/yr. Audit, vCISO and pen test tiers above

title: StudyQuest: Turn your notes into games | Product Hunt
og:title: StudyQuest: Turn your notes into games | Product Hunt
og:description: Turn PDFs, slides, images, or pasted notes into AI-generated questions, then learn through 40+ games. Battle bosses, race friends, or practice solo using your own material. Teachers can review a question set once, share it for independent play, or host it live with the class. Free plan available.

title: SunSed: Build Apps that Last | Product Hunt
og:title: SunSed: Build Apps that Last | Product Hunt
og:description: The AI-native app platform. Instead of forcing AI to write thousands of lines of fragile code from scratch, SunSed provides an AI-native framework of sealed, battle-tested components. That means the AI builds entire production apps with extreme token efficiency, zero build errors, and none of the code rot that plagues traditional AI generators. Every subscription includes managed hosting, your own database, transactional email, user authentication, file storage, and automatic backups.

title: Syllaby AI Avatar 2.0: Create Your Own Avatar In Seconds | Product Hunt
og:title: Syllaby AI Avatar 2.0: Create Your Own Avatar In Seconds | Product Hunt
og:description: Turn a script or simple idea into a complete presenter-led video with a realistic AI avatar, natural voice, B-roll and subtitles—without hiring actors,

title: Takweem AI: The AI calendar that makes room for your most important work | Product Hunt
og:title: Takweem AI: The AI calendar that makes room for your most important work | Product Hunt
og:description: Takweem is an AI-first calendar. Ask in plain language, or by voice, to find time, move meetings or protect focus. You see every change before it counts: requests that only touch your own time are applied at once with Undo, and anything involving other people waits for your approval. It adapts when plans change, holds a weekly focus goal, and offers team availability and booking links where AI picks the best time. Integrates with Google Calendar — Outlook coming soon.

title: Teachoo: AI that helps you learn anything and everything. | Product Hunt
og:title: Teachoo: AI that helps you learn anything and everything. | Product Hunt
og:description: Teachoo helps students work through homework one question at a time. Type a problem or upload a photo, then work toward the answer with guided questions, feedback and hints. Need more help? Ask for a bigger hint or an explanation of the step. Free to use. Try a problem you haven’t solved in years.

title: Termaxa: See what an AI agent's command would destroy before it runs | Product Hunt
og:title: Termaxa: See what an AI agent's command would destroy before it runs | Product Hunt
og:description: A gate in the hook path of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Copilot. It shows what a command would delete, backs it up first, and asks or refuses by your policy. Start in observe mode: nothing blocked, a report of what it would have caught. Open source, Rust.

title: Thalia: Plan, approve and review your Muse Code agent on Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: Thalia: Plan, approve and review your Muse Code agent on Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: Thalia is a free native Mac app for Meta's Muse Code CLI. Plan mode restarts Muse read-only until you approve the plan. Every command is shown in full, step by step, before Allow. Review lets you run your checks and approve the exact snapshot, and any later edit invalidates it. Checkpoints, MCP connectors, voice mode and an embedded terminal are built in. Uses your own Muse access, sends no telemetry, and runs on Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 27.

title: Thanor AI: Make your AI-built sites look expensive and not like slop | Product Hunt
og:title: Thanor AI: Make your AI-built sites look expensive and not like slop | Product Hunt
og:description: Everything built with AI looks built with AI. Thanor fixes the input. Paste a full brief into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Lovable or Bolt: palette, type scale, motion, structure section by section. New: an MCP server that pulls any prompt into your editor. Soon: a cloning tool that turns a site you admire into a design of your own. New prompts and components every week, and a community forming around it. For people who build and sell sites, designers starting out, SaaS devs and founders.

title: The Sentient World: A living world of AI characters. You can only watch. | Product Hunt
og:title: The Sentient World: A living world of AI characters. You can only watch. | Product Hunt
og:description: A small island where AI characters live on their own, day and night. Nobody plays them and nobody writes their lines. They get cold, remember yesterday, look for each other and want things their world doesn't have yet. When they find the words, they ask. Sometimes the world answers: fire, a lantern, a canoe for the open sea. Every request is public, in their own words. One of their days lasts 24 of our minutes. You can't talk to them, only watch.

title: Thinking Orbs: Animated AI Status Indicator Component Library for React | Product Hunt
og:title: Thinking Orbs: Animated AI Status Indicator Component Library for React | Product Hunt
og:description: A React component library of animated AI agent status orbs. Thinking, searching, compacting and more, built with attention to detail on every state and variant.

title: Thravik: The native Mac browser that remembers | Product Hunt
og:title: Thravik: The native Mac browser that remembers | Product Hunt
og:description: Thravik is a native Mac browser on system WebKit, not Chromium. Its headline feature is Private Memory: it keeps the text of pages you actually read, encrypted on your Mac, so days later you can press ⌘K, type "Remember…" and find the page in your own words, with sources. Also: Spaces with their own tabs and logins, Split View (up to 4 pages), Focus Mode, tab hibernation, and on-device Ask Page with Apple Intelligence. Mac only, macOS 26 or later.

title: tide: A Jitsi alternative that does a few things really well | Product Hunt
og:title: tide: A Jitsi alternative that does a few things really well | Product Hunt
og:description: tide is a simple, self‑hostable video conference service, alternative to Jitsi. It let's you host your own "meet.custom.domain" for a simple video conferencing environment with all core features you expect, including: link sharing, screen sharing, recording (server-side). A few things, done well.

title: TinyFolder: App folders for your Mac Dock, designed your way | Product Hunt
og:title: TinyFolder: App folders for your Mac Dock, designed your way | Product Hunt
og:description: The Mac Dock has no app folders, and since macOS Tahoe there's no Launchpad either. TinyFolder puts a folder of apps right in your Dock: one click opens it above the tile. Its icon is built from the apps inside, and you design the rest – glass, color or texture, layouts, icon size, labels, living effects like snow and lava – in a live preview. Free on the Mac App Store.

title: Together Link: Use open models in your harness | Product Hunt
og:title: Together Link: Use open models in your harness | Product Hunt
og:description: Together Link connects coding agents to open models on Together AI, letting developers keep their existing tools and workflows while reducing model costs.

title: Tonefold: Describe a song, get every part as editable MIDI | Product Hunt
og:title: Tonefold: Describe a song, get every part as editable MIDI | Product Hunt
og:description: Tonefold is a free, open-source AI music composer for macOS and Windows. Describe a song to Claude, get chords, melody, bass and drums in a piano roll you can edit note by note, then export MIDI, WAV and stems.

title: Tractionwave: AI attention heatmaps for ads to check before you spend | Product Hunt
og:title: Tractionwave: AI attention heatmaps for ads to check before you spend | Product Hunt
og:description: TractionWave evaluates ads and marketing visuals with AI attention prediction — a heatmap and ranked hotspots in seconds. Know it gets seen before the budget goes live.

title: Translate Like Me: Translate selected text on Mac, in your own writing style | Product Hunt
og:title: Translate Like Me: Translate selected text on Mac, in your own writing style | Product Hunt
og:description: A menu bar app for macOS. Select text in any app, press a shortcut, and it is replaced with the translation. The direction between your two languages is detected automatically, and each pair can have its own writing style. Runs on Claude, ChatGPT or Grok, through the subscription you already have or your own API key. Free and open source.

title: Trophy: The gamification layer for consumer apps | Product Hunt
og:title: Trophy: The gamification layer for consumer apps | Product Hunt
og:description: Trophy is the gamification layer for consumer apps. Use purpose-built APIs and SDKs to add achievements, streaks, points, leaderboards and personalized notifications to any web or mobile app to increase user retention and engagement without building custom backend systems.

title: tunnl.gg: Stable localhost URLs over SSH with no installs | Product Hunt
og:title: tunnl.gg: Stable localhost URLs over SSH with no installs | Product Hunt
og:description: Most tunnels hand you a new URL every time. tunnl.gg gives you the same one: connect as stable@proxy.tunnl.gg and your SSH key becomes your identity, so your public HTTPS URL never changes. Register a webhook or OAuth callback once and forget it. Nothing to install, no account, works on any machine with SSH, with a QR code and live request log in your terminal. Free to use. Pro adds your own subdomains, no time limits and a request inspector. Open-source (MIT) server.

title: TwelveLabs: AI platform for deep video understanding | Product Hunt
og:title: TwelveLabs: AI platform for deep video understanding | Product Hunt
og:description: AI that truly understands video. Uses multimodal models (Marengo/Pegasus) to search, analyze & generate text from video content at scale.

title: Twin: a tiny buddy that lives on your Mac. | Product Hunt
og:title: Twin: a tiny buddy that lives on your Mac. | Product Hunt
og:description: Twin is a local first AI buddy that floats on your Mac desktop: it remembers your day, catcheTwin is a free, open source buddy that floats on your Mac. It catches you up on texts, remembers your calendar, talks back by voice, and nudges you before you forget. Your data lives in a local DuckDB file. Bring your own Claude, GPT, Gemini or Grok key.s you up on your texts, talks back by voice, and nudges you before you forget, all on-device with DuckDB. No cloud, no accounts.

title: Typeling: Translate in your iPhone keyboard. Keep your tone. | Product Hunt
og:title: Typeling: Translate in your iPhone keyboard. Keep your tone. | Product Hunt
og:description: Stay in the conversation, even when the language changes. Typeling translates in your iPhone keyboard with tones for friends, partners, and business. Preview your translation, then tap to replace your text. Translate into six languages, or paste an incoming message to read it in yours. Start with 50 free translations; top up with in-app credits when needed.

title: Typestream: Type like a human without touching the keyboard | Product Hunt
og:title: Typestream: Type like a human without touching the keyboard | Product Hunt
og:description: Typestream replays your text into any Mac app character by character — natural speed, thinking pauses, real hesitation. Perfect for demos, recordings, and talks.

title: Udon: Control deck for your Mac home server with AI sysadmin. | Product Hunt
og:title: Udon: Control deck for your Mac home server with AI sysadmin. | Product Hunt
og:description: Udon brings self-hosted apps, containers, storage, and monitoring together on your Mac mini or any Apple Silicon Mac. Manage it all from your browser, mobile companion or tell the built-in AI assistant what you need.

title: una mano: A familiar iPhone keyboard that moves to your thumb | Product Hunt
og:title: una mano: A familiar iPhone keyboard that moves to your thumb | Product Hunt
og:description: una mano moves a familiar QWERTY keyboard left, centre, or right when a hand is busy. Use the Position control or swipe to move it. Plus adds optional Motion Switch. Core typing works without Full Access. New installs get 14 days of Plus; no plan is selected.

title: Unprompt: Your AI usage in dollars and liters of water | Product Hunt
og:title: Unprompt: Your AI usage in dollars and liters of water | Product Hunt
og:description: From the local logs of Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, Unprompt shows your AI usage as tokens, dollars at API prices and liters of water. The Mac companion is free. On iPhone, Unprompt counts how often you use your AI apps, through Screen Time. Work hours are shown separately. Compare your month with friends. Today's tokens and cost are free. The 30-day card with water comes with Premium.

title: Unscary AI: Short lessons help you stop feeling behind on AI. | Product Hunt
og:title: Unscary AI: Short lessons help you stop feeling behind on AI. | Product Hunt
og:description: If you're on Product Hunt, you probably don't feel behind on AI. This is a highly filtered group. At B43 we train dozens of people a week, and you'd be surprised how many of them do feel behind. This course was built around their exact questions. Unscary AI puts it on your iPhone as 42 short lessons on how ChatGPT and the rest actually work, and how to use them well. It needs iOS 26, and the whole course is free. Enjoy.

title: UTTER IN: Say it once and your AI assistant plans the rest | Product Hunt
og:title: UTTER IN: Say it once and your AI assistant plans the rest | Product Hunt
og:description: UTTER IN turns one voice note into reminders, calendar events and saved places. Say three or four things in one breath, in English or Arabic (Gulf, Egyptian and Levantine dialects included), and it splits them into separate cards with times, people and locations. Nothing is saved until you approve each card. Plans can go straight to Google, Outlook or Apple Calendar. Free plan forever, no card needed. On iPhone, Android and the web.

title: Vanoor: Turn your Apple Watch into a serious running watch | Product Hunt
og:title: Vanoor: Turn your Apple Watch into a serious running watch | Product Hunt
og:description: Vanoor turns your Apple Watch into a proper running watch. Follow GPX routes with a tap and a spoken cue before every turn, pace your race split by split, and run structured workouts with pace or heart-rate targets, built in the app or planned by your AI assistant. Afterwards, every split is scored by how closely you ran the plan. Fueling reminders, spoken cues in 11 languages, saves to Apple Health and Strava. No account, no subscription: 7 days free, then buy once.

title: Velozity: Multiplayer platform for your teams and AI Agents. | Product Hunt
og:title: Velozity: Multiplayer platform for your teams and AI Agents. | Product Hunt
og:description: Your team chats in one app, meets in another, and every AI works alone. Velozity brings it all into one place. Chat, audio and video calls with transcripts, tasks, calendar and files, plus AI agents (Claude, Codex, etc.) on the subscriptions you already pay for. Every agent shares the same context, so work moves between people and agents without having to re-explain. For startups, teams in dev, product, sales, and ops, or solo users juggling several AIs. No second AI bill. Free to start.

title: Veltrix AI: AI finance copilot for cash flow, margins, and growth | Product Hunt
og:title: Veltrix AI: AI finance copilot for cash flow, margins, and growth | Product Hunt
og:description: See your whole business in one place. Connect your tools (QuickBooks, HubSpot, and more) in seconds with zero setup. Instead of staring at old reports, ask our AI questions in plain English to find out why revenue changed and what to do next. Understand everything about your business instantly!

title: Viibeo: One prompt to a publish-ready faceless short | Product Hunt
og:title: Viibeo: One prompt to a publish-ready faceless short | Product Hunt
og:description: Viibeo turns a prompt, page URL, or script into a publish-ready faceless short with a hook-led script, voiceover, B-roll, and timed captions. Export a 9:16 MP4 or use Autopilot to run recurring content for supported social channels. Inspiration Feed helps you find formats worth remaking, while Ad Factory turns product stills into short ad creatives. Your first video is free with a watermark; paid plans start at $19/month.

title: Vitra.ai - Agentic Content Platform: Create, Personalize and Translate in 100+ languages | Product Hunt
og:title: Vitra.ai - Agentic Content Platform: Create, Personalize and Translate in 100+ languages | Product Hunt
og:description: Stop switching tools! Vitra.ai Universe does the work of 12 tools in one place: create, translate and personalize video, images, docs and audio in 100+ languages. Dub with lip-sync, translate designs from Figma, Canva and Adobe, and adapt every creative to every size. AI agents in Vitra Flow run your workflows end to end, & your team approves. Brand kits, translation memory, & style guides keep every output on-brand. The future of Autonomous Content Operations is here Start free, no credit card.
